interpretations.prediction_confidence: Empirical validation-set accuracy for the detector's predicted class at its frozen threshold (E4 EVAL0001 confidence_distribution.csv, split=val), scaled by the detector item's MOD006 reliability weight. Distinct from raw softmax P(fake).
interpretations.evidence_confidence: Mean MOD006 reliability weight across the case's validated collector items (high=1.0, medium=0.6, low=0.3, unusable=0.0), penalized when validation flags conflicting evidence.
interpretations.system_confidence: Fraction of usable validated collector items among all collector attempts and MOD016 case failures for the run.
interpretations.decision_confidence: Forensic certainty attached to the conclusion MOD008 will cite: weighted blend of prediction, evidence, and system confidence, bounded by weak evidence/system health and discounted for single-source or contested leans.
